verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say Pods can use custom containers pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, Amazon ECR), and the CLI accepts an arbitrary image via `runpodctl pod create --image`. Templates are described as pre-configured Docker image setups that can be managed through the CLI, the GraphQL API and the MCP server, which also covers registries. A community user confirms deploying third-party templates in a few clicks, but others note the execution environment is fairly locked down, which may limit fully exact environments. Missing for 10: a step-by-step first-party guide to building and saving your own custom template, clear documentation of private-registry authentication, and independent hands-on reports of running a self-built image.
